resources.string: Set these preferences together with the person. They are individual and are not inferred from a diagnosis.
The kind of support AINGEL should attend to first.
Only sent to Meta if the person allows “Personalize with your profile”.
How much AINGEL explains in each answer.
Spontaneous descriptions of the surroundings (continuous watching)
How often AINGEL describes what it sees, without being asked, while watching.
Repeat the key point at the end
AINGEL ends each answer by repeating the most important point.
What stays in AINGEL and what may go to Meta

Sent with requests to Meta, as categories: form of address, sentence length, pace, one step at a time, explanations, repeating the key point, spontaneous descriptions and what to do when support is requested. No names or notes.
Only with authorization: priority support, if the person allows “Personalize with your profile”.
Stay in AINGEL: the preferred name and free-text notes.
Only someone who can configure this profile can change these preferences.
